notes: Any public repository directly under the transferwise GitHub organization is in GitHub scope except transferwise/pipelinewise.
Repositories outside transferwise are rejected before checkout.
A vulnerability inherited from a third-party library/project is not treated as rewardable without Wise-specific vulnerable behavior or integration.
Sample/placeholder secrets in documentation, examples, tests, fixtures, and CI are suppressed when clearly non-production.
Credential candidates are never validated by this workflow against Wise systems.
Static/scanner output is only a lead. A reportable finding requires repository/commit/path evidence, reproducible proof, demonstrated impact, and duplicate review.
Five issues are known to have been reported, but fingerprints are not available in this policy snapshot; every candidate therefore retains a manual duplicate-review requirement.
